author: Arigenn
body:
Hi everyone.
Remember the PLUG.DJ team? We fell apart, somewhat over the past months. As of now, we have decided to bring this team back!
We will be accepting applications into the team, until we have around 10 players in the team.
Current Members:
MidnightBeats
Skyadia
99250
vladthegreat100
FlufflesSub

If you are interested, please apply in the format below.

IGN:
Skype:
Timezone:
Do you have a PLUG.DJ account?:
If so, what is your PLUG.DJ username?:
Are you active on the forums?
Why do you want to join?:
How could you benefit the Team?:

We would like at least 1 GMT player. You can be from any Timezone, however ;p
You will be put in a Skype chat once you are accepted, and you may apply up to two times. 

MidnightBeats and I will be judging your applications.

Good luck!
